content.comment_body: 1) Is the [article_no] a series [product_name]? Or does it belong to another series? (This post mentions that the [article_no] [product_name] is from the fourth generation.) 2) Which hardware type should be chosen in [product_name] Soft Comfort [version_no] for a network project using [article_no] ([version_no] <-> [product_name]): • [product_name] [version_no] • [product_name] ([product_name] [version_no]) • [product_name] ([version_no].Standard)?

The [product_name] with article number [article_no] is a [product_name] of the third generation, also referred to as [product_name] [version_no]. For hardware selection, you need to choose "[product_name] ([product_name] [version_no])".

analysis.insight_summary: Users are uncertain about how specific article numbers relate to hardware generations and proper configuration within [product_name] software. This confusion affects confidence, especially when setting up network projects that involve integrating different hardware versions.
analysis.user_expectations: Users are seeking clear documentation that links article numbers to their respective hardware generations or versions, along with guidance on correct software setup for their projects.
